title: Lessons from a Fellow Traveler
summary: On Wednesday, March 11, 2015, on the front porch of the Bluewater Bunker, Jordan notices Bob Scott straining his shoulders during a straight-on wheelchair transfer and teaches Mark's father the forty-five-degree pivot technique—leading Bob and Emily to bestow a traditional Appalachian Heart-Hum name upon Jordan by the hearth that evening.

scenes.title: Lessons from a Fellow Traveler and the Heart-Hum Name
